data.rationale: The commit modifies ri_FastPathCheck in ri_triggers.c to call ExecCheckXactReadOnly before locking a referenced row for foreign key validation. This ensures that read-only transactions are prevented from performing row locks on non-temporary tables during fast-path referential integrity checks, matching the existing behavior of the SPI-based check path. This logic is triggered when a foreign key constraint is validated within a transaction that has been switched to READ ONLY mode after data modification occurred, which is typical when using DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED constraints.
seeds: CREATE TABLE pk1 (id int PRIMARY KEY); INSERT INTO pk1 VALUES (1); CREATE TABLE fk1 (id int REFERENCES pk1 DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED); BEGIN; INSERT INTO fk1 VALUES (1); SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY; COMMIT;

CREATE TEMP TABLE pk_tmp (id int PRIMARY KEY); INSERT INTO pk_tmp VALUES (1); CREATE TEMP TABLE fk_tmp (id int REFERENCES pk_tmp DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED); BEGIN; INSERT INTO fk_tmp VALUES (1); SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY; COMMIT;

CREATE TABLE pk2 (id int PRIMARY KEY); INSERT INTO pk2 VALUES (1); CREATE TABLE fk2 (id int REFERENCES pk2 DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED); INSERT INTO fk2 VALUES (1); BEGIN; UPDATE fk2 SET id = 1 WHERE id = 1; SET TRANSACTION READ ONLY; COMMIT;
